name: Bempedoic acid
description: A prodrug activated only in the liver that inhibits ATP-citrate lyase upstream of HMG-CoA reductase, approved for LDL cholesterol lowering and cardiovascular risk reduction. Its liver-restricted activation avoids the skeletal muscle exposure of statins.

systems.note: Cholesterol synthesis inhibition upstream of HMG-CoA reductase; the labelled indication.
Hyperuricaemia and gout are labelled; the drug competes for renal urate transport.

monitors.why: Hyperuricaemia and gout are labelled and mechanistically specific to this drug.
